2.120.33
ChartAxis.MaxFontSize
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartAxis.MaxFontSize element specifies the maximum font size when auto-fitting axis labels.
The ChartAxis.MaxFontSize element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an
RdlSize or an expression that evaluates to an RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is
interpreted as 10pt.
Following is the parent element of the ChartAxis.MaxFontSize element.
Parent elements
ChartAxis
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartAxis.MaxFontSize element.
 <xsd:element name="MaxFontSize" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
